segments.en: At the onset of night one should say: "Behold, I desire to serve Hashem Yisborach in truth, in faith, and in joy — and I hereby bind all my thoughts, speech and actions of the entire day to all the true Tzaddikim of our generation, and to all the true Tzaddikim who dwell in the dust — the holy ones who are in the earth — and in particular to our holy master, the Nachal Novea Mekor Chochmah, Rabbainu Nachman son of Feiga, of blessed memory." And before every prayer one should say: "Behold, I bind my prayer to the true Tzaddikim."

(See Sha'ar HaGilgulim, Introduction 38, where the Ari z"l commanded his disciple Reb Chaim Vital to cleave to the Tzaddikim before prayer — and in particular he commanded him regarding Reb Akiva. The intent of the binding is to pray to Hashem Yisborach according to their faith and their apprehension of Him, and according to their knowledge of the lofty greatness of prayer and the holy combinations of Names and the rectifications of the worlds brought about through prayer.)
